name: admin-widgets-use-metrics-context-not-direct-api
hook: Dashboard widgets must use useMetricsContext, not direct /api/collections/* fetches
body:
Admin dashboard widgets bundled in DashboardWidgets.tsx must use useMetricsContext() from MetricsProvider for data fetching. Direct fetches to /api/collections/* endpoints return 404 because those are Payload admin routes not accessible from the frontend. The RecentTransactionsWidget was fetching /api/collections/transactions directly, causing HTTP 404 errors.

Why: The Payload REST API at /api/collections/* requires admin session/auth that the browser-based fetch from a client component cannot satisfy in this deployment configuration.

How to apply: When adding new dashboard widgets, always use useMetricsContext() or create a dedicated API endpoint under /api/admin/* that the widget can fetch from.
why: The RecentTransactionsWidget was making direct fetches to /api/collections/transactions which returned HTTP 404, while all other widgets (RevenueWidget, TopProductsWidget, CourseEnrollmentsWidget) used useMetricsContext() successfully.
